title: Children's room
description: A children's playroom with a study corner: toys and play furniture, a wooden garage and railway, a bed, a desk and storage.

tasks.text: Lift the white-and-navy toy police car from the end of the desk nearest the room door. Set it on its wheels near the middle of the same desk, slightly toward the chair.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the white-and-navy police car
Set it near the desk center, toward the chair

tasks.text: Find the white-and-navy toy police car on the desk, at the end nearest the room door. Push it away from the desk chair toward the wall behind the desk, keeping it upright on the tabletop.

locatorSteps.label: Push the police car away from the desk chair
Leave the car upright toward the back of the desk

tasks.text: Pick up the green wooden toy car on the road-patterned rug and set it on the toy garage’s lower lift platform. Turn the crank to raise the car to the upper level, let it hold there, then crank it back down with the car still on the platform.

locatorSteps.label: Pick up the green car from the rug
Set the car on the lower lift platform
Crank the loaded lift up and hold it there
Crank the lift back down with the car aboard

tasks.text: Pull open the bottom drawer of the white chest at the foot of the bed. Keep all four folded shirts in the drawer as it opens, then push the drawer fully closed with the shirts inside.

locatorSteps.label: Pull open the bottom drawer with all four shirts inside
Push the drawer shut with the shirts inside

tasks.text: At the cabinet beside the workbench, pull the blue bin out of the bottom middle compartment. Lift it clear with the ball inside, then lower it and slide it back into the same compartment with the ball still in it.

locatorSteps.label: Pull the blue bin straight out
Lift it clear with the ball inside
Return the loaded bin to the bottom middle compartment

tasks.text: Find the red wooden toy car on the desk side of the road-patterned rug. Push it straight ahead in the direction its nose points, then let it roll forward on its wheels and stay upright.

locatorSteps.label: Push the red car straight ahead on the rug
Let it roll forward on its wheels

tasks.text: On the clock on the workbench beside the storage bins, gently turn the short hour hand to 3 and the long minute hand to 12. Let go of both hands so the clock stays at three o’clock.

locatorSteps.label: Turn the short hour hand to 3
Turn the long minute hand to 12
Release both hands at three o’clock

tasks.text: Lift the green rear carriage of the wooden toy train off its straight track, behind the red carriage. Set it inside the white bin on the floor beside the toy garage, then lift it out and put its wheels back on the same track behind the red carriage.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the green rear carriage off the track
Set the carriage inside the white floor bin
Lift the carriage out of the bin
Set its wheels on the track behind the red carriage

tasks.text: Find the towel draped over the stool between the storage bins and the bed. Lift the low hem on the side facing the bins above the stool seat, hold it there briefly, then release it so it hangs back where it started.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the hanging hem on the side facing the bins
Hold the hem above the stool seat
Release the hem so it hangs back down

tasks.text: At the foot of the bed, take the corner of the striped blanket that faces into the room, near the chest. Lift that corner clear of the mattress, hold it up briefly, then release it so it settles back in place.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the room-facing corner at the foot of the bed
Hold the corner clear of the mattress
Release the corner and let it settle back
